data.standardized_narrative: At the 2017 year end the Syndicate's opening gross claims reserves were GBP 1,103.3m. The Syndicate recorded a net release from prior year reserves of GBP 59.2m, driven primarily by more favourable claims development and efficient claims handling. Partially offsetting this was a GBP 52.4m strengthening due to the February 2017 Ogden discount rate change which adversely impacted reserves on 2014 and prior UK Motor treaty business. The 2017 underwriting result was also materially impacted by GBP 74.7m of natural catastrophe losses in Q3/Q4 2017 (Harvey, Irma, Maria, Mexico City earthquake, Northern California wildfires, Nate, Southern California wildfires). RITC activity (acceptance from Syndicate 1400) has restated historical development tables and may distort development patterns.

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit GROSS prior-year movement figure was provided in a 'movement in prior year's provision' line. The report explicitly states a release from prior year reserves of GBP 59.2m but does not label this as gross or net; the triangle has been restated and is distorted by an RITC accepted from Syndicate 1400 (noted in the Technical Provisions), so the gross triangle is unreliable for deriving total prior-year movement. Therefore the reported prior_year_development_gbp_m uses the stated GBP 59.2m release (interpreted as the Syndicate's reported prior-year movement) which is likely net; users should treat this as NET if gross cannot be reconciled from the restated triangle.
